## Hello, traveller

This site is a trail of notes left while wandering through data science, infrastructure, policy and AI.

Some posts are maps. Some are sketches. A few are probably wrong — but hopefully interesting in the attempt.

I write to understand things better, not to look clever. If that sounds like your kind of internet, have a look around.

## The short version

I am a data scientist working in energy networks — currently Lead Data Scientist at Wales & West Utilities, where a lot of my time goes on asset risk, network data and the organisation's direction on AI. Alongside that I am working through an MSc in Data Science at the University of St Andrews.

## What I believe about data work

- **A number is only as good as the rule that produced it.** If nobody can re-run it, nobody can defend it.
- **Uncertainty belongs on the page.** A figure with honest error bars beats a precise one nobody trusts.
- **The decision is the point.** A model that does not change what someone does is a hobby.
- **Presentation is part of the analysis.** The reader only has the document.
- **Being wrong in public is cheaper than being wrong in a submission.** That is partly why this site exists.

## What you will find here

Longer pieces on [method](writing.qmd#category=method) and [asset data](writing.qmd#category=asset%20data), thinking-out-loud on [AI strategy](writing.qmd#category=AI%20strategy) in regulated settings, and the occasional note on making documents that hold up under scrutiny.
